extracted.name: No Time to Cook Chicken
extracted.description: Canned soups and sour cream blend into a smooth sauce for chicken in this crock pot recipe.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of celery soup
instruction_lines: Place chicken breasts in a slow cooker. In a medium bowl, mix the cream of chicken soup and cream of celery soup until smooth Pour over the chicken, making sure it is well coated.
Cover, and cook on Low heat for 7 to 8 hours. Stir in the sour cream about 1/2 hour before serving.
